items.title: DoorDash Takes to the Sky With Its Own Drones
items.summary: DoorDash  for years has rushed online orders from burritos to cold medicine to customers’ homes via bike couriers and drivers.  Now the delivery provider is adding a new mode of transport: air.  DoorDash on Wednesday said it has secured a key certification from the Federal Aviation Administration to make commercial deliveries using drones.
